decisions.summary: Add a read-only package footprint policy gate that classifies ship-profile buckets, reports budgets, and surfaces dev-only candidates without mutating files.

expected_metrics.target: 0 hard budget failures in the default report
at least 9.5/10 after ship-profile classification is CI-visible

verification_commands.expected: status warn or pass with 0 failures and 0 irreversible actions
maintenance profile includes package-footprint-policy as a read-only step

observed_results.summary: P21 adds the policy gate, schema, operator docs, CI step, and maintenance profile integration.

decisions.rollback_or_follow_up: Rollback by removing the CI and maintenance profile steps if the warning signal is too noisy; follow up with an explicit package exclusion profile only after operator review.
